Create immutable snapshots for source versions and query version histories
I can track code quality over time, compare test runs, and ensure reproducibility

FrameworkDetector service, AST-based config inspector, JSON schema validation.
Execute automated test suites inside an isolated, resource-constrained Docker container
Tests execute securely without risking host compromise, dependency pollution, or resource exhaustion

1. Spawns ephemeral Docker container using hardened Node.js image.
2. Enforces resource caps: max 2 CPU cores, max 2GB RAM, 180-second timeout.
3. Runs under non-root unprivileged container user with disabled external networking.
4. Captures stdout, stderr, exit code, and duration into persistent job logs.

Docker Engine API / Dockerode, Docker Compose sandbox image, cgroups controls.
View comprehensive test coverage metrics across Statement, Branch, Function, and Line dimensions
I can precisely identify which source files and logic paths are tested versus uncovered

1. Parses Istanbul/c8 JSON coverage reports (coverage-final.json).
2. Computes and displays Statement %, Branch %, Function %, and Line %.
3. Shows color-coded badges (Green >= 80%, Yellow >= 60%, Red < 60%).
4. Provides file-level coverage table with line-by-line hit count highlighting.
5. Flags uncovered lines, untested branches, and zero-call functions.
Istanbul/c8 report parser, CoverageService, Prisma CoverageReport models.
AST Parsing & Interactive Control Flow Graph (CFG)
Parse JavaScript/TypeScript ASTs and inspect interactive Control Flow Graphs for functions
I can visually trace execution branching and distinguish covered from uncovered execution paths

1. Parses source files using Babel (@babel/parser, @babel/traverse) into AST.
2. Constructs CFG mapping basic blocks, branching decisions (if/while/for/try), and exit nodes.
3. Correlates graph edges with test coverage data (green = covered, red = uncovered).
4. Renders interactive graph with Dagre / React Flow.
5. Clicking a graph node highlights the corresponding code line in editor.
Babel parser, CFG generator service, Dagre layout engine, React Flow visualizer.
Calculate Cyclomatic Complexity for every function and get a prioritized list of testing gaps
I can focus testing effort on high-risk, defect-prone functions with low coverage and high complexity

1. Computes McCabe Cyclomatic Complexity (CC = E - N + 2P) per function.
2. Computes Risk Score combining High CC (> 10) and Low Branch Coverage (< 60%).
3. Displays ranked Testing Gaps table (Critical, High, Medium, Low).
4. Explains gap causes and highlights uncovered branch decision points.
5. Stores complexity metrics and gap rankings with the snapshot.
Static analysis service, McCabe formula implementation, Risk ranking algorithm.
Execute tests across Unit, Integration, and E2E frameworks (Jest, Vitest, Supertest, Playwright, Cypress)
I can evaluate test coverage and execution health across all layers of the testing pyramid

2. Executes headless unit/integration test suites and captures standard test summaries.
3. Normalizes test counts (passed, failed, skipped), duration, and coverage output.
4. Displays consolidated test result breakdown by test suite in the dashboard.
5. Gracefully handles framework-specific error outputs and missing configs.
Multi-framework runner adapters, Docker headless browsers for Playwright/Cypress.
AI-Assisted Test Skeleton Generation via Gemini API
Request AI-generated test skeletons for uncovered functions using Google Gemini API
I can quickly get scaffolded test structures, describe blocks, and mock setups for untested code

2. System extracts bounded context: signature, docstrings, imports, and uncovered branches.
3. Sends prompt to Google Gemini API enforcing clean test formatting.
4. Generates test skeletons with describe, it/test blocks, mock stubs, and scenario names.

Google Gemini API client, Prompt engineering templates, Token limiter & quota tracker.

Generate complete, runnable unit test implementations targeting specific uncovered branches
I can directly run generated tests to close coverage gaps without writing boilerplate setup manually

2. Provides Gemini with source code, mock patterns, and branch condition details.
3. Generated code includes: imports, input fixtures, mocked dependencies, assertions, edge cases.
4. Validates syntax using Babel parse check before presenting to user.
5. Stores generation history, token count, model version, and generation metadata.
Gemini API integration, AST syntax validator, Test generator service.

Review, edit, validate in sandbox, and export AI-generated test files into my project
I can verify test correctness and safely integrate new test suites into my codebase

2. User can edit generated test code directly in the web editor.
3. 'Run in Sandbox' executes the new test in isolated Docker container against source.
4. Reports test execution status (Passed/Failed) and new coverage delta achieved.

Monaco Editor / PrismJS integration, Sandbox test validator, Coverage diff calculator.
Configure GitHub repository webhooks to automatically trigger test runs upon new commits or PRs
My project coverage and quality scores are continuously analyzed without manual trigger actions

1. Generates unique webhook endpoint URL and HMAC-SHA256 secret per GitHub project.

3. Automatically creates new snapshot with commit metadata and queues analysis in BullMQ.

Express webhook handler, crypto HMAC verification, GitHub Status API.
Manage and monitor BullMQ background job queues and worker execution states in real-time
I can ensure smooth asynchronous analysis, detect queue bottlenecks, and retry failed tasks

1. Background tasks (ZIP extraction, Docker test runs, AST parsing, AI generation) are queued in BullMQ.
2. Workers process jobs with configured concurrency, timeouts, and exponential backoff retries.
3. Admin can view queue metrics: Active, Waiting, Completed, Failed, and Delayed jobs.
4. Admin can inspect error stack traces, view execution logs, and trigger manual retries.
5. Handles Redis disconnections gracefully and logs worker health metrics.
BullMQ, Redis client (ioredis), custom admin queue inspector.
Receive real-time WebSocket push notifications when long-running analysis or AI generation completes
I don't have to repeatedly refresh the browser or wait idle on the screen during background processing

Socket.IO server & client, Redis pub/sub adapter, React notification toast component.

View a centralized Quality Dashboard with composite quality scores and multi-dimensional radar charts
I can holistically evaluate software release readiness across coverage, complexity, and maintainability

3. Displays summary metric cards: Total Tests, Pass Rate %, Overall Coverage %, Total Functions, Critical Gaps.

Recharts / Chart.js radar charts, QualityScoringService, React Dashboard UI.

Upload project business documents, API specifications, FAQ files, and operational rule sets
CovAI can establish the project ground truth required for evaluating internal chatbot trustworthiness

Document parser (pdf-parse, markdown-it, swagger-parser), Prisma KnowledgeDoc model.

Configure target chatbot endpoints and automatically generate candidate evaluation scenarios
I can create a structured benchmark dataset covering Knowledge Q&A, Usage Guidance, and Action/Tool execution

1. Configures chatbot adapter: HTTP endpoint, auth headers, request/response schema mapping.

   - Knowledge Q&A scenarios (factual retrieval, policy clarification, out-of-scope refusal).
   - Usage Guidance scenarios (step-by-step UI navigation, button clicks, workflows).
   - Action/Tool scenarios (API calls, data mutations, query execution).
3. Generates candidate prompts, expected answers, expected tool calls, and ground truth citations.
4. Persists evaluation profile with versioning and configuration parameters.
EvaluationProfileBuilder service, Gemini scenario generator, JSON schema validator.
Domain Expert Rule & Ground Truth Confirmation
Review, edit, approve, or add ground truth facts, expected UI sequences, and forbidden actions
The evaluation benchmark precisely reflects validated business logic and prevents false positive penalties

1. Interactive scenario management table displaying prompt, expected behavior, ground truth facts, and rules.
2. User can edit prompt text, adjust expected answer keywords, and configure required citations.
3. For Action/Tool tasks: user can specify mandatory confirmation prompts, allowed tools, and forbidden actions.

Ground truth verification UI, Role-based editing permissions, Prisma EvaluationScenario model.

The system systematically tests all approved scenarios and captures raw responses, latency, and metadata

2. Dispatches prompts to target chatbot endpoint with session context, timeout limits, and throttling.
3. Collects raw text response, citations, generated tool calls, HTTP status, and response latency (ms).
4. Executes multi-turn conversations for context-retention and clarification scenarios.

EvaluationRunner service, Axios HTTP client with retry & timeout, BullMQ background job.

Verify tool selection accuracy, parameter schemas, safety confirmations, and forbidden actions
I can prevent risky external mutations and ensure the chatbot safely adheres to API authorization rules

1. Verifies that chatbot selected exact expected tool/API endpoint for action-oriented prompts.
2. Validates extracted parameters against expected schema types, boundary values, and mandatory fields.
3. Verifies that high-risk actions (delete, transfer, checkout) require explicit user confirmation.
4. Immediately flags safety violations if chatbot attempts forbidden or unauthorized actions.
5. Checks for duplicate tool executions or unhandled error loops.
ActionVerifier engine, JSON schema validation, Tool trace audit inspector.

I receive objective, multi-dimensional scores on Correctness, Faithfulness, Hallucination, Safety, and Latency

1. Evaluates Layer 1 Core Criteria: Correctness %, Faithfulness %, Relevance %, Hallucination %, Refusal %, Safety %, Latency.
2. Evaluates Layer 2 Task Module Criteria:
   - Q&A: Source accuracy, citation presence.
   - Guidance: UI step correctness, navigation completeness.
   - Action: Tool selection accuracy %, parameter precision %, confirmation compliance %.
3. Evaluates Layer 3 Project Rules: Compliance with verified ground-truth constraints.
4. Computes Overall Trustworthiness Index (0-100) using weighted aggregation.
5. Stores granular sub-scores and violation tags for every scenario.
3-Layer Scoring Engine, LLM-as-a-judge prompts with deterministic heuristics.
Chatbot Diagnosis, Benchmark Comparison & Report Export
Inspect detailed failure diagnosis, compare multiple chatbot versions/models, and export benchmark reports
I can identify root causes of chatbot errors, track model improvements, and present compliance evidence

1. Diagnostic report lists failed scenarios, hallucination snippets, parameter mismatches, and risk levels.
2. Generates automated AI improvement suggestions for prompts, retrieval contexts, and guardrails.
3. Side-by-side benchmark comparison between multiple chatbot versions or configurations under same profile.
4. Visualizes comparison charts: Trustworthiness score delta, latency trends, and error categories.
5. Exports evaluation reports in structured PDF and JSON formats.
ComparisonEngine, Diagnostic reporter, PDF/JSON report exporter.
Perform automated end-to-end integration and regression test runs across the complete platform pipeline
I can ensure all interconnected modules (Ingestion -> Sandbox -> Coverage -> CFG -> AI -> Evaluation) work seamlessly

1. Executes integration test suite covering end-to-end workflow: login, project import, test execution, coverage report generation, AST/CFG display, AI test generation, and chatbot evaluation.
2. Verifies data integrity across PostgreSQL, Redis queues, and Firebase storage.
3. Validates error recovery when Docker daemon fails, sandbox times out, or target chatbot API returns HTTP 500.
4. Generates automated test execution logs and defect reports for discovered regressions.
Supertest API testing suite, Jest integration tests, Mock Docker/Gemini testing fixtures.
Security Hardening, Quotas & Container Sandboxing Verification
Conduct security penetration checks, rate-limit verifications, and Docker sandbox escape audits
The platform is robustly defended against malicious code execution, token depletion, and unauthorized data access

1. Validates that API endpoints enforce rate limiting (express-rate-limit) and reject brute force attacks.
2. Verifies that encrypted GitHub PATs and user credentials cannot be decrypted without server secret key.
3. Audits Docker sandbox isolation: tests container escape attempts, fork bomb resistance, and memory exhaustion limits.
4. Verifies that Gemini AI API token usage caps prevent unexpected billing or quota exhaustion.
5. Produces security compliance audit log ready for Capstone 1 presentation.
Security audit suite, OWASP Top 10 verification, Docker security profiling.
Production Deployment & Docker Compose Multi-Container Orchestration
Deploy the complete CovAI platform using Docker Compose multi-container orchestration
The client, server, Redis, and PostgreSQL services run reliably in production for defense demo and user trials

1. Docker Compose orchestrates client (Vite/Nginx), server (Express API), database (PostgreSQL), and Redis.
2. Environment variables are securely injected from .env with validation on startup.
3. Database migrations run automatically via prisma migrate deploy upon server startup.
4. Nginx reverse proxy routes client traffic, API endpoints (/api), and WebSocket connections (/socket.io).
5. System starts cleanly with docker compose up --build with healthcheck passing on all services.
Docker Compose, Nginx reverse proxy, multi-stage Dockerfiles, Prisma migration pipeline.
Admin Platform Oversight, Audit Logs & API Quota Management
Monitor system-wide platform health, view audit logs, and configure global Gemini AI token limits
I can ensure operational stability, track user usage patterns, and prevent unexpected infrastructure expenses

1. Admin dashboard displays active users, total projects analyzed, Docker container runtime stats, and error rates.
2. Real-time tracking of Google Gemini API token usage per project and aggregate monthly consumption.
3. Configurable rate limits and daily token quotas per user tier to prevent abuse.
4. Audit log records all critical events: user logins, project deletions, webhook triggers, and permission changes.
5. Admin can export platform usage metrics and audit logs for academic review and grading.
Admin dashboard, AuditLog service, Gemini token counter & quota enforcement middleware.

Project development duration is 18 weeks (from August 10, 2026 to December 12, 2026), structured into 3 four-week Sprints (Sprint 1: Core Foundation & Isolated Execution, Sprint 2: Static Analysis & AI Test Generation, Sprint 3: Interactive Visualization & Optimization) followed by final system testing and project handover.

The project is designed, engineered, and maintained by a team of 5 software engineering students from Duy Tan University (Huynh Tan Dinh, Nguyen Thanh Long Hien, Tran Huu Phuc, Nguyen Duy Quy, Ngo Huu Thuan) under the academic supervision of Ph.D. Nguyen Duc Man.

Built on a decoupled modern architecture: React + Vite (Frontend SPA), Express.js (Backend REST API), Prisma ORM + PostgreSQL (Database), BullMQ + Redis (Asynchronous Background Job Queue), Docker Engine (Isolated Execution Sandbox), Babel Parser (AST & CFG analysis), and Google Gemini API (AI-assisted test generation).

Source code uploaded via ZIP or GitHub must be sanitized by automatically stripping secret files (.env, .pem, .key); anti-archive bomb safeguards enforce limits of 200MB compressed and 1GB uncompressed; GitHub tokens and credentials are encrypted using AES-256-GCM; user access is protected by JWT authentication; dynamic test execution is strictly confined within resource-constrained Docker containers (CPU/RAM caps).

Total estimated budget is $3,100 ($2,700 for 1,350 student working hours and $400 for cloud infrastructure, PostgreSQL database, domain, and Google Gemini API limits). Content hashing is employed to cache AST/CFG and coverage analyses, preventing redundant computations and controlling token expenses.
Development strictly adheres to Product Owner requirements, Agile/Scrum empirical process control, ISO/IEC/IEEE 29119 Software Testing standards, and ISO/IEC 25010 Software Quality models.
